doc: Legs excluded from the M3a validation-set pass requirement (docs/M3_PLAN.md Sec. 4.1, 5.1; docs/M3A_VALIDATION.md Sec. 'Quarantine'). Gates are still run and reported for them. A leg leaves quarantine only by passing G3-G5 with the evaluator class named here fixed.

legs.reason: DDH with negative H3 and fitted STIG. PINT 1.1.7 rejects it (DDH -> M2 < 0); zeroing H3 would also zero the STIG design column. The only evaluator that reads it is tempo2 itself, so there is no independent cross-check; the PINT fix (nanograv/PINT#2023) is unmerged (open, 2026-10-08).
pre-fit wrms / TRES = 2.40 (survey screen); PB + FB1.. without FB0 (canonicalised to FB0 = 1/PB)

lifted.reason: ELL1H with H3+H4 and no NHARMS: PINT uses >= 7 harmonics, tempo2 4
lifted.lifted: 2026-10-08: tempo2 harmonic convention (NHARMS = 4 when the par gives none) applied at ingestion (profiles.TEMPO2_PAR, legs.load_leg); with it PINT matches tempo2 to 0.9-5 ns projected rms and column-space sin 7e-5..4e-4, the level of the other non-quarantined legs (docs/M3A_VALIDATION.md Sec. 12). With PINT's forced 7 harmonics the leg differs by 17-128 ns and sin up to 1.0.
